# A correlated block of small LLMs next to humans, RTE (generated by scripts/run_correlated_block_rte.py)

800 pairs, 50% positive. AUC, mean over 20 shuffles of each pair's 10 labels into 10 human columns. Intervals: 95%, resampling draws and items.

## The raters

| Rater | AUC | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|
| One human label (mean over slots) | 72.9 | 72.9 |
| Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-4bit, short | 75.8 | 58.4 |
| Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct-4bit, guide | 74.4 | 64.4 |
| Qwen3-0.6B-4bit, short | 76.5 | 50.2 |
| Qwen3-0.6B-4bit, guide | 75.7 | 50.1 |
| Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit, short | 89.8 | 81.2 |
| Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit, guide | 88.7 | 78.0 |
| Qwen3-1.7B-4bit, short | 87.7 | 80.5 |
| Qwen3-1.7B-4bit, guide | 85.1 | 77.4 |

Within-class correlation (conditional dependence): human-human 0.04, tiny LLM-tiny LLM 0.66, human-tiny LLM 0.09.
